summary: Identified specification contradiction in cancellation policy rules between user and provider flows.
evidence: Identified conflict between Paragraph 1 update ('all cancellations within 24 hours receive full refund; cancellations after 24 hours non-refundable') and Paragraph 2 / original spec ('providers set their own cancellation policies and those apply when users cancel').
Analyzed failure mode: ambiguous precedence between platform global policy and provider custom autonomy, impact on escrow refunds and provider revenue guarantees.
